docs.title: Kneo Agent
docs.text:
Documentation for the Kneo Agent SDK and the Kneo Agent Platform.

  • Kneo Agent SDK

    Python library for building, composing, and running agents — tools, MCP, middleware, streaming, human-in-the-loop, observability.

    :octicons-arrow-right-24: Read the SDK docs

  • Kneo Agent Platform

    Service and control plane that runs agents in production — deployment, CLI, HTTP API, security hardening, backup and recovery.

    :octicons-arrow-right-24: Read the platform docs
